entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Treaty_Ceremony_Intro
entries.dialogueText: The Grand Throne Room of Palas Rezna had been arranged for the formal ratification of the Treaty of Zille. Foreign ambassadors, military commanders, and provincial nobles lined the marble hall beneath portraits of Rizian kings. The parchment instrument rested upon the central table beside the royal seal of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Treaty_Declaration
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty... The guns have fallen silent. The ink dries upon the instrument of peace, and the scribes await your royal seal to close this chapter in the annals of Rizia.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Outcome_Hub_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: You stepped forward to the table to ratify the outcome of the campaign.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Decisive_Victory
entries.dialogueText: In the presence of Saint Wruhec and the nobles of Rizia, I affix the royal seal. Zille is liberated and reunited with the Kingdom of Rizia!
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Restoration: Zille returns to the Crown of Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Decisive_Ceremony
entries.dialogueText: The hall erupted into thunderous cheers, bells pealing from every sanctuary in Porte Drazon. Hugo wiped tears of joy from his eyes, bowing deeply before his King. "Nearly thirty years of grief washed away in triumph! Long live King Romus the Restorer!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Overwhelming_Triumph
entries.dialogueText: By this treaty, Wehlen surrenders Zille unconditionally, pays immense war indemnities, demilitarizes its southern shore, and recognizes the Free City of Grodzizg. House Toras has achieved absolute triumph!
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Total Reparations: Wehlen humbled and Grodzizg placed under protection!"
entries.userScript: Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_PromisedToHouseToras"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.MapLayer_Zille_Brenas"] = true; Variable["Grodzizg_FreeCity"] = true;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Overwhelming_Ceremony
entries.dialogueText: Lucita unsheathed her ceremonial saber and saluted with shining eyes. "An epochal triumph, Your Majesty! We have not merely reclaimed our homeland—we have broken Wehlen's military power for a generation!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Independent_Buffer
entries.dialogueText: To spare our people further carnage, I sign the charter establishing the Independent Neutral State of Zille. May this neutral territory forever stand as a peaceful bridge rather than a battlefield.
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Neutrality: The Independent Republic of Zille is established."
entries.conditions: ((Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 3 or Variable["Zille_Independent_Buffer"] == true or (Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 0)

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Buffer_Ceremony
entries.dialogueText: Laurento bowed solemnly. "The Alliance of Nations applauds your royal wisdom, Your Majesty. Though the province is not annexed, peace and guaranteed transit across the strait are secured."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Tactical_Defeat
entries.dialogueText: With a heavy heart, I sign this armistice. Our brave soldiers fought with unmatched valor, yet we must preserve the realm's strength. Zille remains outside our borders... for now.
entries.menuText: "Sign the Armed Armistice: Withdraw to the pre-war frontier under an uneasy truce."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Tactical_Defeat
entries.dialogueText: A somber silence fell over the court. Hugo sighed deeply, his shoulders bowed with grief. "A bitter day for House Toras, Romus. Yet the realm endures, and we must rebuild."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Total_Fiasco
entries.dialogueText: To prevent the destruction of Porte Drazon, I sign this humiliating peace. May God forgive me for the tragedy that has befallen our kingdom.
entries.menuText: "Sign the Instrument of Surrender: Concede southern Brenas to save Porte Drazon."
entries.userScript: Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = false; Variable["Brenas_Lost_To_Wehlen"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.Azaro_HasPowerToCoup"] = true;

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Ack_Total_Fiasco
entries.dialogueText: Shouts of outrage and fury broke out among the assembled officers. Duke Taddeus stormed from the hall in disgust, while dark whispers of a military coup echoed through the stone corridors. The monarchy stood on the brink of collapse.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Treaty_Declaration
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. The diplomatic instrument lies before you, witnessed by the envoys of the Alliance of Nations. The realm awaits your royal signature.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Decisive_NoHugo
entries.dialogueText: Thunderous applause filled the Grand Throne Room as cathedral bells rang across Porte Drazon. Laurento bowed deeply. "A historic restoration, Your Majesty. Zille is home."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Overwhelming_NoLucita
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro raised his saber in crisp salute. "An epochal victory, Your Majesty. Rizia stands unchallenged across the Gulf of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Tactical_Defeat_NoHugo
entries.dialogueText: A heavy hush fell over the chamber. Laurento lowered his eyes solemnly. "A bitter hour, Your Majesty, yet the kingdom remains intact to fight another day."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Ack_Total_Fiasco_NoTaddeus
entries.dialogueText: Shouts of outrage broke out among the assembled noble houses and generals. Officers slammed their sabers onto the marble floor, and dark whispers of mutiny echoed through the corridors of Palas Rezna.
